ValidationRule.description: This validation ensures the order is change to Reviewed by Order Management team only after "Rev Rec Rules Reviewed" flag is checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Order_Validation_to_Change_Status) , NOT( NSP_Rev_Rec_Rules_Reviewed__c ) , ISCHANGED( Status ) , OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Reviewed' ) , ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ) , 'Draft' ) ) , AND( ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Activated' ) , ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ) , 'Draft' ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The order can only be marked as Reviewed once the "Ready for Review" flag is checked.
